items.note: 5.3% above the first $4,811 ($9,622 married), less the $155 grocery credit per person, which is refundable.

provisional: The $4,811 / $9,622 zero-rate band is the 2025 amount; Idaho indexes it and publishes the 2027 amount with its withholding tables
